articleTitle: Research on the Traveling Wave Extraction Method Based on WOA-VMD and Cubic Spline Interpolation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on the Frontiers of Electronic, Electrical and Information Engineering (ICFEEIE)
abstract: The traveling wave fault distance measurement method is high accuracy for ranging and fast positioning speed. This method is mainly used in high-voltage transmission lines. The extraction of traveling wave signals and the identification and calibration of traveling wave heads are the basis and prerequisite for the time-domain reflectometry method. The accuracy of head recognition and extraction has a bearing on the precision of traveling wave ranging. In current research, due to the non-stationary nature and strong singularity of traveling wave signals, some head extraction methods may encounter issues such as susceptibility to interference, slow extraction speed, weak adaptability, modal aliasing, and insufficient local feature focusing ability during application. This leads to unsatisfactory results in traveling wave head extraction. For these reasons, this paper proposes to use the Whale Optimization Algorithm-based Variational Mode Decomposition method (WOA-VMD) to address the method adaptability issues in traveling wave head extraction. Additionally, in order to further improve head recognition accuracy and reduce calibration errors in head moments, this paper presents a traveling wave extraction method based on WOA-VMD combined with cubic spline interpolation. This will provide assistance for the widespread using of traveling wave fault distance measurement in power systems.

articleTitle: An Anti-Jamming SCMA Method Using Turbo-Hadamard Codes for Satellite Communications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on the Frontiers of Electronic, Electrical and Information Engineering (ICFEEIE)
abstract: Given the demand for ubiquitous connectivity and massive service access in future wireless communications, the application of sparse code multiple access (SCMA) to satellite communications has great potential. However, exposed links of satellite communication make it more vulnerable to malicious jamming, which will seriously affect the reliability of the system. In this paper, the frequency hopping technique and the low-rate codes are jointly applied to the anti-jamming SCMA based the uplink satellite-terrestrial communication. The frequency hopping technique distributes the information to different frequency bins to reduce the probability of user signals being jammed. Meanwhile, the low-rate codes stretches the bit information to redundant bits so that the jammed bits can be recover at the receiver. The paper also compares the anti-jamming performance between turbo codes retransmission and low-rate turbo-Hadamard codes under the same code rate. The simulation results show that the low-rate turbo-Hadamard codes have superior performance in anti-jamming.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Rapid Construction Method of Distribution Network in Power System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on the Frontiers of Electronic, Electrical and Information Engineering (ICFEEIE)
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings of existing technology, a digital twin method of distribution network based on electrical and spatial topology is proposed. The digital twin of power grid should start from the real-time state of equipment, spatial layout of equipment, topology information and design specification. First of all, the real-time data of 5G network access to the Internet of Things sensing device or measurement center is used to realize the monitoring of online information, so as to ensure the real-time status display of the equipment in the twin body of the power grid. Then, the topology linkage of the digital twin objects is realized. Finally, check whether the space layout and the topology connection conform to the specification according to the design specification of the power grid. This scheme meets the requirements of the scene modeling method in terms of accuracy and fidelity, and greatly improves the efficiency of designers in the distribution network design and scene analysis in the digital twin space.

articleTitle: An Improved Sine Cosine Algorithm with Chaotic Crossover Operator for Feature Selection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on the Frontiers of Electronic, Electrical and Information Engineering (ICFEEIE)
abstract: Feature selection is a crucial data-preprocessing step for dealing with classification problems. It can move useless or redundant features without sacrificing classification performance. This paper proposes an improved sine cosine algorithm with chaotic crossover operator (SCAC) to select the most informative feature subset. SCA is an emerging and effective optimization algorithm based on the sine and cosine trigonometric functions. SCA has shown efficiency in global exploration but it still faces the problem of falling into local optima. To prevent local optima stagnation and enhance the search capacity of SCA in feature selection problem, a chaotic crossover operator is developed to expand exploration area and enhance diversity of the population during evolution process. A time-varying selection probability is used to decide the adequate updating mechanism of the individuals. To testify the effectiveness and reliability of SCAC, five feature selection approaches are used for comparison on 12 datasets of different sizes. The results of comparative studies prove that SCAC can effectively improve classification accuracy and reduce feature subset size. Furthermore, the comparison of execution time proves the computational efficiency of the proposed SCAC.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Communication Network for Distributed Photovoltaic Access in Power System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on the Frontiers of Electronic, Electrical and Information Engineering (ICFEEIE)
abstract: The distributed photovoltaic grid-connected voltage level is low, and the dispatching does not master its operation information, which brings great safety risks to the stable operation of the power grid. In view of these problems, the communication fusion network scheme for the whole county distributed photovoltaic cluster access is put forward. This scheme conducts quantitative evaluation of multi-mode communication technology for optical fiber communication, wireless private network, wireless public network, and power line carrier communication through four dimensions, that is service classification, network performance index, economic cost of network construction, technology maturity and industry chain. A prototype prototype based on flexible access based on distributed PV was developed and tested in the laboratory. This scheme effectively improves the communication access, carrying capacity and security protection capability of distributed photovoltaic, and provides theoretical basis and technical support for distributed photovoltaic communication networking, network security, edge terminal deployment and cluster control.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Fast Fourier Transform in Harmonic and Inter-Harmonic Detection of New Power System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on the Frontiers of Electronic, Electrical and Information Engineering (ICFEEIE)
abstract: The large-scale integration of renewable energy sources such as wind and photovoltaic into the power grid, along with the extensive use of power electronic devices at the “source-grid-load” end, has introduced a significant amount of harmonics and inter-harmonics signals into the power system, posing posing a severe threat to the stable operation of equipment at all levels within the power system. Therefore, accurate detection of harmonics and inter-harmonics signals is of paramount importance for control systems to precisely execute switching actions, implement fault warnings, and conduct post-fault analysis and tracing. However, current research on harmonics and inter-harmonics detection in power systems, both domestically and internationally, remains in its infancy stage, and the theoretical framework and methods need to be further refined. This paper initially provides a detailed overview of the current research status of harmonic and inter-harmonic measurement technologies in power systems. It then introduces the fundamental principles of Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) in harmonic detection and existing research findings. Finally, through MATLAB simulations, this study explores the influence of relevant parameters in FFT on detection accuracy. This paper can provide necessary support for subsequent researchers to conduct harmonic research in power systems.

articleTitle: Design and Verification of a Bidirectional Loads Bearing and Low-Impact Pyrotechnic Release Device
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on the Frontiers of Electronic, Electrical and Information Engineering (ICFEEIE)
abstract: For the remote sensing camera's two-dimensional turntable launch process is easy to cause damage to the rotating components and affect the scanning accuracy and image quality, designed a bidirectional loads bearing and low-impact pyrotechnic release device. The U-shaped frame can be locked and supported to improve the rigidity of the mechanism and prevent the rotating components damage during the launch. The release device can active avoid after work in orbit. Based on the design of the impact reduction, complete the simulation analysis and structural optimization, through the product ground test and flight verification, the results show that: the device can achieve 12kN – 70kN tensile and compressive load, form an active avoidance distance of 5mm – 7mm. The work impact is less than 4000g, which means the device can be used for high- precision load.

articleTitle: Luminous Characteristics of High-Voltage Green Mini-Light-Emitting Diodes
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on the Frontiers of Electronic, Electrical and Information Engineering (ICFEEIE)
abstract: By dividing the green mini-light-emitting diode (mini-LED) mesa into sub-mesas and connecting them serially, the luminescence characteristics of the high-voltage (HV) green mini-LEDs are investigated. The temperature-dependent electroluminescence (TDEL) results show that the high energy level peak caused by the exciton transition below 160 K can enhance the emission of the green emitting peak. When the current is above 10 μA, the contribution of Auger recombination exceeds that of the Shockley-Read-Hall (SRH) nonradiative recombination. The variation of the chromaticity coordinates of green HV mini-LEDs with temperature is more pronounced at a current injection above 100 μA.

articleTitle: A Range Alignment Method Using Deep Learning for MMW ISAR Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on the Frontiers of Electronic, Electrical and Information Engineering (ICFEEIE)
abstract: Range alignment is an important step in the imaging process of inverse synthetic aperture radar (ISAR) radar. In this paper, a novel deep learning network model is proposed to effectively tackle the challenge of distance alignment in millimeter-wave (MMW) ISAR imaging. The proposed model leverages a multi-layer bidirectional long short-term memory (bi-LSTM) network architecture to learn intricate features among echoes, thus facilitating precise alignment along the range direction. Meanwhile transfer learning was used to enhance the adaptability of the model to multiple signal-to-noise ratios (SNR). Experiment results show that the aligned images generated by proposed model in this paper are closer to the reference images in low SNR environments compared to traditional methods.

articleTitle: A Low-Power, High-Accuracy CMOS Sensor Integrated with Analog-Front-End Circuit and Analog-to-Digital Converter for Ultrasonic Partial Discharge Online Monitoring of Power Grid Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on the Frontiers of Electronic, Electrical and Information Engineering (ICFEEIE)
abstract: This article introduces a Sigma-Delta analog-to-digital converter and its analog front-end circuit for partial discharge detection in gas insulated switchgear and other power grid devices, based on 180-nm CMOS technology. Analog front-end circuit can effectively detect partial discharge, preprocess the detection signal, amplify it and reduce noise interference. Sigma-Delta analog-to-digital converter adopts a second-order four bits quantization Sigma-Delta modulator to reduce quantization noise and further improve the signal-to-noise ratio of the system, while adopting dynamic elements matching technology to reduce random errors. The output rate of the digital filter can be adjusted to better adapt to the digital signal processing unit. The simulation results indicate that, under a 5V power supply voltage, the SNR is 112.8 dB, the effective number of bits is 18.3 bits, and the power consumption is 4.3 mW.

articleTitle: Calculation of Ice Cover Thickness on Transmission Lines Based on Mechanical Modelling
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on the Frontiers of Electronic, Electrical and Information Engineering (ICFEEIE)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a mechanical model for overhead transmission lines with ice cover to address issues related to ice accumulation. We conducted comprehensive data analysis and in-depth result mining by thoroughly examining the amount of ice accumulation and utilizing existing monitoring methods. When constructing the mechanical model, we considered the flexible characteristics of the conductor, which are primarily influenced by axial tension. Additionally, we incorporated non-uniform load distribution and complex surface models to more accurately depict the line shape changes. The model integrates crucial parameters such as the tilt angle of the suspension point, wind deflection angle, and tension measurements with the equation of state of the line to determine the equivalent ice cover thickness. A comparison of the field monitoring data with the calculated values of the model reveals a minimal discrepancy, indicating the model's high predictive accuracy and its capability to faithfully represent the ice cover conditions.

articleTitle: Research on Sensorless Switching Technology for High Definition Video Signal
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on the Frontiers of Electronic, Electrical and Information Engineering (ICFEEIE)
abstract: Video and picture are important carriers of information, but most of the video switching devices on the market have the phenomenon of black screen delay and low definition. In view of this phenomenon, this paper puts forward a non-inductive switching device of HD video signal, starting from the demand of HDMI information source matrix switching, combined with the function of HDMI matrix switching, control HDMI switch, and realize the non-inductive switching of multi-video information source matrix switching with high definition and high stability.

articleTitle: Defect Detection Based on Global Feature Enhancement and Multi-scale Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on the Frontiers of Electronic, Electrical and Information Engineering (ICFEEIE)
abstract: To mitigate the challenges associated with low pre cision and long processing time in the detection of surface de fects on magnetic tiles, a method for defect detection based o n global feature enhancement and multi-scale fusion is propo sed. Firstly, a channel and position cooperativity enhanceme nt module (Coordattention) is incorporated into the feature f usion layer (Neck) of YOLOv5 to ensure a global receptive fi eld and accurately encode the positioning information of the features. Secondly, an efficient multi-scale enhancement mod ule (EMA) is embedded in the feature extraction layer (Back bone) to effectively handle short and long-distance dependen cies and integrate context information at different scales. Thi s method utilizes a parallelization strategy for convolutional kernels to avoid excessive sequential processing and overly d eep hierarchical structures. Experimental results demonstrat e that this method can rapidly and accurately detect various defects from low-contrast images, significantly reducing the t ime overhead of machine operations and improving the accu racy of image-driven defect detection.

articleTitle: The Impact of Trap Evolution Caused by Pulse Stress on the Electrical Characteristics of the Device
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on the Frontiers of Electronic, Electrical and Information Engineering (ICFEEIE)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to discuss the electrical characteristics variations of a 650V trench-type SiC MOSFET with low on-resistance and high switching speed under different filling and testing conditions. The experimental results indicate that more accurate and stable electrical parameters can be obtained after a certain period of gate filling. Trap activation energy is characterized using transient current methods, and the gate traps are located. In addition, different pulse stresses were applied to the device gate to characterize the effects of different stress conditions on threshold voltage changes and trap evolution.

articleTitle: Research on Robust Control of Power Quality in Subway Power Supply System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on the Frontiers of Electronic, Electrical and Information Engineering (ICFEEIE)
abstract: The capacity ratio of harmonic suppression device and reactive power compensation device cannot reach the optimal value in the comprehensive power quality control optimization of subway power supply. This situation will lead to the waste of the capacity of a device, which will eventually reduce the reliability of the actual project and increase the project cost. An optimization scheme with a robust controller is designed. After the robust controller is designed for the filter and reactive power compensation device, it is connected to the system. The main feature of the scheme is to improve the internal robustness of the system, which is because the optimization device interferes with each other during the operation of the system, reducing the stability and capacity ratio of the system. Therefore, the addition of a robust controller can finally ensure that the harmonic suppression device and reactive power compensation device work together, improve the working efficiency of the two, improve the capacity ratio, and finally further optimize the harmonic distortion rate and power factor in the subway power supply system, fully in line with national standards.

articleTitle: Novel LDPC Code-Aided Modified CME-Based Anti-Jamming Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on the Frontiers of Electronic, Electrical and Information Engineering (ICFEEIE)
abstract: Direct sequence spread spectrum (DSSS) system is extensively utilized in modern satellite communication systems owing to its inherent anti-interception and anti-jamming capabilities. However, the anti-jamming performance of the system is constrained by its spreading ration. While a larger spreading ration increases the jamming margin, it also leads to an expansion in signal bandwidth, thereby resulting in reduced communication efficiency and wastage of spectrum resources. The consecutive mean excision (CME) algorithm shows the potential to enhance the system's resistance to jamming for a fixed spreading ratio. Nonetheless, it is limited in effectively addressing residual burst errors in the channel. In this paper, an LDPC code-aided anti-jamming strategy based on modified CME is proposed. By introducing overlap windowing and overlap addition operations, the CME algorithm is optimized to achieve jamming detection and suppression in the frequency domain. Moreover, the logarithmic likelihood ratio (LLR) of the despread signal is modified, along with decoding based on the belief propagation (BP) algorithm to further improve the error-correcting capability of the DSSS system. Simulation results compared with the traditional algorithm demonstrate that the proposed method has significantly improved communication performance against narrowband jamming.

articleTitle: Research on Performance Optimization of Cooling Fan Based on GA-BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on the Frontiers of Electronic, Electrical and Information Engineering (ICFEEIE)
abstract: The cooling fan plays a vital role in the heat dissipation of the automobile engine, and its performance optimization is of great significance for improving the working efficiency and service life of the engine [1]. This paper aims to achieve accurate prediction and optimization of the performance of cooling fan cascades through the BP neural network model. The network is trained by simulation data, allowing it to precisely capture the changing patterns of cascade performance. Subsequently, genetic algorithms are employed to optimize the weights and thresholds of the neural network, enhancing its predictive capabilities and stability. The experimental results demonstrate that the optimized BP neural network model exhibits excellent performance in terms of prediction accuracy and stability. This model is not only capable of accurately predicting the performance of cooling fan cascades but also provides robust data support for performance optimization.

articleTitle: Electric Discharge Device for Destruction of Large-Sized Objects Based on Reverse Switching Dynistors
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on the Frontiers of Electronic, Electrical and Information Engineering (ICFEEIE)
abstract: The report presents the results of research aimed at creating a highly efficient device based on reverse switching dynistors (RSD), which ensures the destruction of large objects by powerful electrical discharges in water. The operating principle of the RSD developed at Ioffe Institute (St. Petersburg, Russia) and physical processes that make it possible to create powerful shock waves in water that can destroy concrete and stone blocks with a size of ~ 1 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> are described. A schematic electrical diagram of the developed RSD device is shown. The principle of its operation is described. The design of a RSD device that ensures the destruction of a large object is shown. The oscillograms of the output voltage pulses and discharge current obtained during testing of the RSD device are presented. Photographs of destroyed concrete blocks and large stones obtained using the developed RSD device are shown. The prospects for further work in this direction are considered.

articleTitle: Infrared and Visible Image Fusion Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on the Frontiers of Electronic, Electrical and Information Engineering (ICFEEIE)
abstract: As an important medium for obtaining and transmitting information, images have become increasingly widely used in various areas, including national defense observation, the identification of objects, and the guidance of vehicular transit. Due to limitations in photography equipment or environmental conditions, a single image often cannot provide comprehensive information. To overcome this limitation, image fusion technology has emerged and attracted research interest, where data from multiple images are integrated by using image fusion algorithms utilizing Retinex with a CNN-structured framework for broad-spectrum image fusion, designated as IFCNN. In this work, images obtained under low lighting conditions have been processed and analyzed through image fusion technology. Utilizing the LLVIP dataset, 40 collections of images that include both the infrared and visible spectrum were selected. Visible light images have been processed employing multi-scale Retinex with color restoration (MSRCR) algorithm. Subsequently, fused images can be generated by combining infrared images with enhanced visible light images using the IFCNN method. The results suggest that our approach to image fusion is capable of effectively enhance the color hierarchy and detail information of nighttime images while exhibiting strong real-time performance.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Characteristics of a UA V Wing Based on Operational Modal Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on the Frontiers of Electronic, Electrical and Information Engineering (ICFEEIE)
abstract: Structure of UA V is subjected to complex aerodynamic forces when flying in the atmosphere, and the structural dynamics problems are obvious. The modal parameters of UA V wing are the input conditions for UA V dynamic design and aeroelastic analysis, and are one of the important parameters in UA V design. This paper first introduced PolyMAX modal recognition method and operational modal theory, and then took the wing structure of a UA V as the research object. In order to obtain its dynamic characteristic parameters, this paper conducted modal tests on the wing structure. Based on PolyMAX modal recognition method and operational modal theory, the wing modal test system was built. The experimental modal analysis (EMA) and operational modal analysis (OMA) methods were used to identify the modal parameters of a wing, and the modal parameters (natural frequency, modal, damping ratio) of the wing were obtained. At last, the experimental and operational modal results are compared and analyzed. The results show that the operational modal test method is suitable for the structural modal analysis under environmental excitation and has high precision.

articleTitle: Recognition Detection Method Based on Multi-Scale Feature Template Matching
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on the Frontiers of Electronic, Electrical and Information Engineering (ICFEEIE)
abstract: A recognition detection method based on multi-scale feature template matching is proposed to address the inefficiency of logistics warehouses that mainly rely on manual recording and code scanning to recognise the brand identity on cartons when transferring carton goods.

articleTitle: Enhanced Robustness Modeling Strategy and Stability Analysis for Microgrid Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on the Frontiers of Electronic, Electrical and Information Engineering (ICFEEIE)
abstract: One of the reasons for the restriction of the development of microgrid fault diagnosis and flexibility is that the initial modeling contains many uncertainties and variables. At present, there is a lack of optimal modeling for multi-level robustness in existing modeling methods. In this paper, a new multi-level enhanced robustness modeling approach is proposed, which takes into account the switching topology characteristics of constant frequency microgrids. The active power is an equation tracking method of power and voltage, and the reactive power tracking value is a specific ratio of the measured one. In this paper, the modeling method is built using the primary and secondary level multi-level switchable matrices. The stability analysis is verified by mathematical formula derivation. The reliability of the model and the effect of the control system are proved by system simulation in MATLAB/Simulink when the switching topology and uncertain parameters are included. The modeling strategy proposed in this paper can be used to improve the flexibility and stability of microgrids.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Multi-Mode Reconfigurable Frequency Source Based on AD9914
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on the Frontiers of Electronic, Electrical and Information Engineering (ICFEEIE)
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of a versatile frequency source based on the AD9914, focusing on its software configuration design. The system architecture, including FPGA and AD9914 integration, is detailed along with the algorithmic calculations for parameter configuration. The test results indicate that the frequency source can generate a single-frequency signal, as well as linear frequency-modulated signals with pulse widths ranging from 2us to 50us and bandwidths ranging from 2MHz to 50MHz.Test results demonstrate the system's capability to achieve multiple mode reconstructions, offering high flexibility and superior performance, thus holding promising prospects for diverse applications.

articleTitle: Development of a Locking and Releasing Mechanism for the Two-Dimensional Turntable of a Space Camera
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on the Frontiers of Electronic, Electrical and Information Engineering (ICFEEIE)
abstract: In this paper, a light and small locking and releasing mechanism with separation nut is proposed to control the locking and releasing of the two-dimensional turntable of a space camera. The separation nut is designed to clamp and fix the camera turntable, and the device is fastened by the bolt pre-tightening force. A pyrotechnic method is used to generate high-pressure gas to drive the separation nut to unlock. A bolt activation device is designed to store the energy, allowing for the release of bolt constraints and freedom of the turntable. To verify the reliability of the mechanism and its adaptability to complex space environments, static strength tests, dynamic tests, separation nut unlocking tests, and unlocking and impact tests of the entire mechanism were conducted. The results showed that the locking and releasing mechanism can stably lock and release camera loads, and has the characteristics of small size, light weight, low impact, and high reliability.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-point Cross-coupling Compensation Control Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on the Frontiers of Electronic, Electrical and Information Engineering (ICFEEIE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that cross-coupling between multiple loading channels affects the loading accuracy during aircraft fatigue test, based on the Mechanical Testing & Simulation (MTS) control loading system, the transfer function mathematical model of the control system is studied from the loading characteristics of the fatigue test control channel, and the application scheme of multi-point cross-coupling compensation technology is studied. To verify the effectiveness of the decoupling algorithm in the coupling relationship of multi-point cooperative control, the number of feedback errors in the loading channel increased from 92.56% to 97.65%, which effectively improves the loading control precision of fatigue test, and has great significance.

articleTitle: Research on Warning Technology for External Force Damage Targets of Transmission Lines in Inland Waterways
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on the Frontiers of Electronic, Electrical and Information Engineering (ICFEEIE)
abstract: The conventional real-time monitoring and early warning technology for transmission line breakout targets primarily relies on the CBAM (Convolutional Block Attention Module) self-attention mechanism to extract target characteristics. However, this approach is susceptible to the influence of the foundational layer mapping, leading to suboptimal monitoring and early warning indicators. To address this, a novel real-time monitoring and early warning method for transmission line breakout targets is proposed, utilizing 3D laser radar technology. This method constructs a multi-sensor acquisition coordinate system for monitoring data of external broken targets on transmission lines, leveraging 3D laser radar to extract the real-time monitoring and early warning characteristics of these targets. Consequently, it achieves effective real-time monitoring and early warning of external broken targets on transmission lines. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed 3D laser radar-based monitoring and early warning technology exhibits high precision, recall rate, average accuracy rate, and F-value for external broken targets on transmission lines. These findings substantiate the method's excellent performance, reliability, and potential application value.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Aircraft PHM Load Calibration Test Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on the Frontiers of Electronic, Electrical and Information Engineering (ICFEEIE)
abstract: Failure prediction and health management (PHM) loading calibration test of aircraft supports the optimization of aircraft structural strength design, stand-alone life evaluation and structural maintenance plan formulation by obtaining the aircraft structural load-time history. This paper carries out technical research on aircraft load calibration test loading, data acquisition and test analysis. It employs an integrated loading system for the experimental design, achieving safe and accurate implementation of load calibration tests. It utilizes a method of simulating test data through on-board remote interface unit testing to synchronize on-board data with test data. Based on the principle of linear superposition, it constructs load equations to assess the bending moment and shear force conditions of the structure. The aircraft PHM load calibration test technology is validated, and the results show that the experimental loading control error is less than 1 0/0. The test data exhibits good linearity, and the prediction error of the load equation is within 3%.

articleTitle: Estimation of State of Charge Based on BC-VFFRLS Parameter Identification and MRCKF Algorithm for Lithium-ion Batteries
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on the Frontiers of Electronic, Electrical and Information Engineering (ICFEEIE)
abstract: State-of-charge of lithium-ion batteries is a pivotal indicator in energy storage systems that is intimately associated with battery performance and safety, requiring accurate estimation. Taking the ternary lithium-ion battery as the research object, this study proposes a BC-VFFRLS method based on the 2-RC equivalent circuit model to identify the dynamical changes of the model parameters. Utilizing the MRCKF algorithm, the study achieves a refined estimation of SOC, thereby enhancing the precision of lithium battery SOC estimations. The parameter identification is verified through HPPC tests, and the SOC estimation results are validated through BBDST conditions and DST conditions. Validation leads to the fact that the SOC error under BBDST conditions is maintained within 0.72%, and under DST conditions, the SOC error is stably controlled within 1.02%. The experimental results thoroughly verify the proposed algorithms for their high accuracy and convergence.

articleTitle: Enhanced Layered Quasi-Cyclic Low-Density Parity-Check Codes for the McEliece Cryptosystem in Satellite Communications System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on the Frontiers of Electronic, Electrical and Information Engineering (ICFEEIE)
abstract: Given the rapid advancement of quantum computing technology, the McEliece cryptosystem, rooted in coding theory, stands out as one of the few cryptographic systems resilient against quantum attacks. Nevertheless, the system's extensive public key length and low transmission rate have hindered its practical utility. To overcome these challenges, we propose a methodology to implement the McEliece cryptosystem employing quasi-cyclic low-density parity-check (QC-LDPC) codes, thereby diminishing the public key size albeit at the expense of height-ened decryption complexity. Furthermore, we introduce a row-layered normalized min-sum low-density parity-check decoding algorithm aimed at minimizing system complexity and optimizing hardware resource utilization.
